text.p: Tele-Communications Inc has received clearance from the Securities and Exchange Commission for its plan to spin off its satellite unit, a company spokesman said on Friday.
The distribution date for the spinoff of TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc will be December 4, the spokesman said.
TCI Satellite will trade on NASDAQ.
Later, Tele-Communications said in a statement that its stockholders will receive one share of Series A common of the satellite unit for each 10 shares of Tele-Communications Series A stock held.
Stockholders will receive one share of Series B satellite unit stock for every 10 shares of Tele-Communications Series B stock held.
The satellite unit stocks will trade under the symbols TSATA.O and TSATB.O.
